title: 第五章 不对劲的周哲第六章 奇葩
content_zh:
楚元一夜没睡，一边修行一边注意着时间；
直到过了半夜十二点，脑海中的系统面板果然有所变动！
他眼睁睁的看着那个转化次数从0变成了1
便迫不及待的拿出今天黄波给他的那些个武道丹药。
拿起一瓶气血丹，正要让系统转化，忽然想起了什么
于是把几个玉瓶中的丹药都倒腾出来，全部塞进了气血丹的玉瓶中小卡一手bug。
反正系统又没说可以转化几枚
“转化！”
【转化中
获得聚气散*5！
今日转化次数0！】
“”楚元有些遗憾，bug没有卡上；
也有可能是自己卡的方式不对
他没有太过在意，又把塞得满满登登的玉瓶倒腾出来，便看见底部那五枚散发着微微荧光的丹丸。
虽然名字叫聚气散，可还是丹丸形状；
取了一枚放在手心，除了感知到里面充盈的灵气之外，也看不出什么特殊的地方。
楚元也不再纠结，直接吞服；
一瞬间！庞大的灵气在体内扩散开来
窗外的各种声音鲜活入耳，厨房内，母亲正在做饭；
听起来，似乎是在煎蛋？

楚莹的房间内，有些许轻鼾传来
楚元蓦然睁开双眼，一道流光在他眼底划过，隐没不见。
再看自己这个小房间，似乎和之前有了不同的感受；
连地板上细小的灰尘形状都看的清清楚楚！
耳聪目明，这便是耳聪目明
感受着体内潺潺流淌的法力，他颇为满意；
按照筑基法上所说，自己现在应当是在练气三层！？
从入门到练气三层，只不过用了区区一晚上时间！
代价则是转化而来的那五枚聚气散消耗完毕难道自己不仅仅是个武道天才，还是个修仙天才？
这一夜修炼，体内倒是没有新的杂质再析出来。
稍微自得了一下，门外便传来母亲的叫喊“元元，莹莹，起床吃饭了！”
洗漱完毕，坐在饭桌前；
楚莹一手拿馒头，一手拿筷子，却忽然翘着鼻子凑到楚元旁边嗅了两下。
“”楚元嫌弃的按着她的脑袋推到了旁边。
“哥，你喷香水了？”
“你有病吧？”
韩翠也不在乎两人在饭桌上闹，这个家从来都没有那么多规矩；
只是也跟着闻了闻，笑道“是有一股香气。”
楚元怔了一下，放下筷子抬起胳膊闻了一下；
也许是之前没有在意，现在果然闻到一股淡淡的清香。

不过不是什么香水的味道，更类似于草木，还有些其他的硬要说的话，大自然的气息？
心中有了猜测，便解释道“可能是昨天吃了丹药的原因。”
“你皮肤也变好了耶！”楚莹盯着他的胳膊，继续惊奇；
“行了行了，吃饭堵不住你的嘴。”
虽然黄波说了可以在家自己修炼，但其实很少有人那么做；
content_en:
Chu Yuan stayed up all night, paying attention to the time while practicing;
It wasn't until midnight that the system panel in my mind changed!
He watched helplessly as the number of conversions changed from 0 to 1
He couldn't wait to take out the martial arts pills that Huang Bo gave him today.
I picked up a bottle of Qi and Blood Pill and was about to let the system transform when I suddenly remembered something.
So he emptied out the elixirs from several jade bottles and stuffed them all into the jade bottle of Qi and Blood Pill.
Anyway, the system doesn’t say how many coins can be converted.
"Transformation!"
【Converting
Obtain Qi Gathering Powder*5!
The number of conversions today is 0! 】
"" Chu Yuan was a little regretful that the bug was not fixed;
It's also possible that you're stuck in the wrong way.
He didn't pay too much attention, and emptied out the filled jade bottle, and saw the five slightly fluorescent pills at the bottom.
Although the name is Juqi San, it is still in the shape of a pill;
I took one and put it in the palm of my hand. Apart from sensing the spiritual energy inside, I couldn't see anything special about it.
Chu Yuan no longer hesitated and swallowed it directly;
A moment! Huge spiritual energy spreads within the body
The various sounds outside the window are vivid to my ears. In the kitchen, my mother is cooking;
Sounds like you're frying an egg?
In Chu Ying's room, there was a slight snoring.
Chu Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, and a stream of light flashed across his eyes before disappearing.
Looking at my small room again, I seem to have a different feeling than before;
Even the shapes of fine dust on the floor can be seen clearly!
The ears are clear and the eyes are clear, this is the ears and eyes are clear
Feeling the mana flowing through his body, he was quite satisfied;
According to the foundation building method, I should be at the third level of Qi training now! ?
From getting started to the third level of Qi training, it only took one night!
The price is that the five converted Qi Gathering Powders have been consumed. Is he not only a martial arts genius, but also a cultivation genius?
After practicing this night, no new impurities were released from the body.
After feeling a little complacent, my mother shouted from outside the door, "Yuanyuan, Yingying, get up and eat!"
After washing, sit at the dinner table;
Chu Ying held the steamed buns in one hand and chopsticks in the other, but she suddenly turned her nose up and sniffed at Chu Yuan twice.
"" Chu Yuan pushed her head aside in disgust.
"Brother, are you wearing perfume?"
"Are you sick?"
Han Cui didn't care about the quarrel between the two at the dinner table. This family never had so many rules;
He just sniffed it and said with a smile, "There is a fragrance."
Chu Yuan was startled for a moment, then put down his chopsticks and raised his arm to smell it;
Maybe I didn't notice it before, but now I smell a faint fragrance.
But it's not the smell of perfume, it's more similar to the smell of grass and trees. There are other things that I have to say, the smell of nature?
With a guess in his mind, he explained, "Maybe it's because I took the pill yesterday."
"Your skin has improved too!" Chu Ying stared at his arm and continued to be surprised;
"Okay, okay, I can't keep your mouth shut while eating."
Although Huang Bo said that you can practice at home, few people actually do that;
